description: This file defines a controller class 'Sale' in the OpenCart admin module, responsible for generating sale report tasks and listing product sales data. It contains methods to initialize report tasks and compute sales figures for products, interacting with models for products and sales.

classes.name: Sale
classes.description: Controller class for generating and listing sale report data within the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes sale report tasks by dividing products into pages and creating report tasks for each page.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Calculates and updates the total sales for products, returning a success message with the current list segment.
